value.rationale: The sharp multiplier (R/r)^(d+2) is independent of convex-body shape, anisotropy and frequency separation, a useful exact condition-number control for extrapolating two plane waves on higher-dimensional symmetric observation domains. The nonattainment and directional small-gap loss quantify the worst near-collision behavior via a natural geometric kurtosis ratio. It is not a freely selected finite table or a mere known one-dimensional interval spectral identity: the all-convex-shape universal law and its quantitative collision structure are the primary conclusion. Applications include precise noise amplification for two-component Fourier models observed on centrally symmetric convex windows.
